svg.title: Two-Stage and Multistage Filtration
svg.desc: Source shows separators and staged filters with valves, pumping, monitoring, backwash and drain circuits. Key: 回灌过滤系统 = reinjection filtration; 地热监测系统 = geothermal monitoring; 膜过滤系统 = membrane filtration; 反冲洗水 = backwash water; 压力排水 = pressurised drain; 自动排气阀 = automatic air-release valve; 单阀水嘴 = sampling tap; 止回阀 = non-return valve; 温度变送器 = temperature transmitter; 压力变送器 = pressure transmitter; 电磁流量计 = electromagnetic flow meter; 截止阀 = shut-off/globe valve; 球阀 = ball valve; 循环泵 = circulation pump; 输水管路 = water piping; 输电管线 = electrical wiring; 反洗管线 = backwash piping. Filter grades and pressure limits are project-specific.
